independence: DID_NOT_BUILD_OR_EXECUTE. Current public Google documentation and bounded saved policy/claim review only; no live Merchant/Shopify account, source product query, private customer/order/credential read or peer/canonical write.

official_sources.title: Set up your return policies for Shopping ads and free listings
evidence_locations: lines121-144: processing-time field and label assignment
supported_facts: A policy may cover one or multiple countries. Additional countries can be added if not already included in a different policy.
A standard policy plus product-specific exception policies is supported. Exception labels must be applied to the intended feed products.
Default or blank labels select the default policy. Policies must agree with an accessible website and be verified before Google uses them.
The setup guide describes refund-processing time in days until the customer receives a refund; it does not identify business versus calendar days.
unknowns: Actual US/AU country choices, overlaps and exception-country inheritance in Merchant513542500 require current native evidence.
No explicit business/calendar unit or safe value conversion is established.

official_sources.title: Return policy label [return_policy_label]
evidence_locations: lines21-48: non-default policy assignment and default fallback
supported_facts: The attribute assigns a non-default policy to a product/group; absence uses the configured default.
The field is not repeated, supports up to100 characters and must be encoded appropriately.
official_sources.review_implication: Check exact recognized labels on every affected exception offer; category wording or saved local labels alone do not prove effective Google policy.

official_sources.title: Returns [returns]
evidence_locations: lines19-45: offer overrides, country and window type
lines51-59: fee defaults and policy URL
supported_facts: Product-level returns can override account policies, with country-specific details.
The specification includes NO_RETURNS and DEFECTIVE_ONLY options; applicability to this store must follow its actual policy.
Omitted shipping/restocking amounts can imply zero in this offer-level format, so blanks are not a harmless substitute for unknown fees.
official_sources.review_implication: Inventory effective offer-level overrides as well as labels; do not introduce this separate mechanism merely because it exists.

official_sources.title: Create and manage your online return policies
supported_facts: The guide shows policy IDs, country lists, labels and processing fields available in policy readbacks.
Its processRefundDays explanation describes seller processing in days, without specifying business versus calendar units.
The separate policy-review period may take up to10 business days; that review period does not define refund-processing units.
official_sources.review_implication: Native helper text or an authoritative field definition must resolve the unit and start/end milestone before choosing a number.

captured_window_utc.limit: Clock bounds for this collection; per-action timestamps were not captured.

saved_policy_facts.return_request_window: 30 days from delivery; new/unworn/unwashed/original packaging/tags and additional stated condition requirements.
saved_policy_facts.refund_processing: After receipt/inspection and approval,5–10 business days to original payment method; bank posting may take an additional2–5 business days. These milestones must not be collapsed into an invented Merchant number.
saved_policy_facts.shipping: Customer return-shipping responsibility except damaged/defective; original shipping nonrefundable. No explicit restocking amount is supplied by this saved text.
saved_policy_facts.defective_limit: Saved policy separately describes damaged/defective replacement or full refund without return. Broad no-return labels must not be represented as removal of every defective-item remedy.

current_local_ownership.scope: Merchant513542500; existing US10727274744/AU10727245667; free-listing scope and exact return/delivery gates retained

refund_day_unit_answer.reason: UI help describes days to customer refund receipt; API guide describes days for seller refund processing. Neither reviewed definition states business or calendar days. Policy-review business days are a separate clock.

independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Merchant513542500, exact9309759641, current country list/status, all other relevant standard and exception policies, their labels/countries and any existing US/AU conflicts. Record whether changing a standard country list also changes exception country scope; do not infer inheritance.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: The intended US/AU change is an exact allowed delta with Austria and unrelated policies preserved.

independent_prechange_criteria.test: Match actual current written and displayed policy
independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Fresh accessible US/AU policy/PDP wording and authoritative Shopify policy source, including delivery/request-window meaning, condition, exclusions, damaged/defective remedy, exchanges, return-label responsibility and fees. The Sep12 source is dated evidence, not a Sep14 website check.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: Every proposed field agrees; no new restocking amount, return address, promise, country restriction or unqualified no-remedy statement is invented.

independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Exact native field/helper and, if still ambiguous, authoritative Google clarification defining business/calendar days and seller-processing versus customer-receipt endpoint. Reconcile receipt/inspection/approval and separately stated bank posting.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: A truthful exact value is supported. Do not substitute10 calendar days, add bank ranges mechanically, or use zero/another default for an unknown. If optional, preserve/omit only after proving omission semantics.

independent_prechange_criteria.test: Cover the complete currently affected offer population
independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Current US/AU effective-policy matrix across direct feeds, discovered/other sources and any offer-level returns overrides. Match all swimwear/intimates, Final Sale and gift-card exceptions that are present; enumerate excluded/held/offered rows and unknown classification separately.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: Every affected exception offer has the intended recognized country-policy binding; default-eligible products remain default. Do not substitute older720,4923 or4761 counts for a fresh current classification.

independent_prechange_criteria.test: Prove truthful sequencing and rollback before release
independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Frozen exact country/policy/feed-label before-state, candidate field diff and staged order of operations showing no interval when excluded offers inherit an incorrect blanket return promise. Country expansion must not outrun recognized applicable exceptions/received labels.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: Each intermediate state and the rollback preserve truthful coverage; otherwise retain the exact unresolved gate. Rollback restores only changed policy-country/label/override fields and preserves Austria, source identities/prices/holds and peers.

independent_prechange_criteria.test: Define independent after-state evidence and limits
independent_prechange_criteria.required_evidence: Reopened native country/policy/exception/status readback plus Google-received attributes/effective policy for normal and excluded offers in each target country; full reconciliation counts and negative checks for missing/incorrect labels.
independent_prechange_criteria.clears_when: Saved configuration, policy verification, offer ingestion, eligibility/serving and sales/profit are reported separately. This review does not approve the proposed change or infer StoreQuality improvement.

limitations: The four selected official pages are current browsed documentation; incidental search results were not adopted as additional authorities.
Documentation availability is not exact current account capability, policy-country coverage, product classification, atomic deployment or permission proof.
No public store revisit, current offer enumeration, actual refund operation or legal-rights interpretation was performed.
Old policy/contact/access/cohort clocks in the Sep12 source remain historical; no other lane or measurement deadline is reset.
